Payslip — Footer — View

This screen displays the current payslip footer that will appear at the bottom of all payslips issued to employees.

The footer typically contains important information such as payment instructions, company policies, or legal disclaimers that need to be included on every payslip.

You can preview exactly how the footer will appear on printed or emailed payslips before making any changes.

To edit the footer content, see: Footer
